DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないというご相談ですね。ご自身の自転車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a bicycle you can't find. Is it your own bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄から借りた自転車です。駐輪場へ戻ると見つからず、自分の物ではないので登録番号も覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄から借りた車体が見当たらず、自分の物ではなく登録番号は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed it from my older brother. When I returned to the bicycle parking area, I couldn't find it. It isn't mine, so I don't remember the registration number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the bicycle borrowed from your older brother is missing and, since it is not yours, you don't know the registration number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借り物であることも記録します。色や付属品、停めた場所を思い出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll record that it is borrowed too. Do you remember its color, accessories, and where you parked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青色で後ろにかごがあります。ただ、入口の右と左に駐輪場所があり、どちらに停めたかは自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青色と後ろかごを説明し、入口左右のどちらに停めたかは不確かと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's blue with a basket at the back. But there are parking areas to the right and left of the entrance, and I'm not certain which side I used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, describe the blue color and rear basket, and explain that you're unsure whether you parked to the right or left of the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 位置が不確かな点はそのまま伺います。車体の写真や、持ち主に確認できる連絡先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll keep the uncertainty about the location as you describe it. Do you have a photo or a way to contact the owner to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 兄に連絡できます。携帯の写真には自転車が写っていますが、番号までは読めないので、登録の書類もあるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄へ連絡でき写真はあるが番号は読めず、登録書類の有無も尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can contact my brother. The bicycle is in a photo on my phone, but the number isn't readable, so I'll also ask whether he has the registration papers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you can contact your brother and have a photo but cannot read the number, and will ask about registration documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。管理者による移動があったかも確認する必要があります。周りに似た自転車はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. We also need to check whether the manager moved it. Were there any similar bicycles nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い自転車はありましたが、かごの形が違いました。間違えて動かさず、そのままにして来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た青い車体はかご形状が違い、誤って動かさず残したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was a blue bicycle, but its basket had a different shape. I left it where it was rather than move it by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that a similar blue bicycle had a different basket shape and you left it without mistakenly moving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その判断で結構です。似ているだけでは同じ車体とは決められません。見当たらないと気づいた時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That was appropriate. Similarity alone doesn't establish that it's the same bicycle. Please tell me when you noticed yours was missing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 気づいたのは今朝ですが、昨夜からなくなっていたかはわかりません。兄と管理者に確認し、わかった情報だけ追加で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見当たらないと気づいたのは今朝だが消失時期は不明で、兄と管理者から得た確かな情報だけ追加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noticed this morning, but don't know whether it had been gone since last night. I'll check with my brother and the manager, and add only information I've established.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you noticed the bicycle missing this morning but don't know when it disappeared, and will add only confirmed information from your brother and the manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では青色とかごの特徴、位置と時期が不確かな点を記録します。写真を拝見し、確認する項目を順に整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll record the blue color and basket features, along with the uncertain location and timing. Let's look at the photo and organize what to check in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 応募先への封筒をお持ちですね。提出案内に、残しておく記録や発送方法の条件は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an envelope for an application recipient. Do the submission instructions specify records to keep or conditions for the shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募書類で、案内には「受け取りまで確認できる方法」とあります。送ったときのレシートがあれば足りるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募案内は受取まで確認できる方法とあり、差出時レシートだけで足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's application documents, and the instructions say ‘a method that lets you confirm receipt.’ Is the receipt from when I send it enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the application instructions require a method that confirms receipt and ask whether the sending receipt alone is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差し出した記録と、相手に届いたことを確認する記録は別です。案内のその部分を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A record of sending and a record confirming delivery to the recipient are different. May I see that part of the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。追跡できれば、相手の担当者が書類の内容まで確認したこともわかるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内を示し、追跡から相手の担当者による内容確認までわかるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. If it has tracking, can I also tell whether the recipient's staff checked the contents of the documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the instructions and ask whether tracking also shows that the recipient's staff checked the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達状況の記録だけで、相手が内容を確認したとか、応募を受理したとは言えません。提出先が必要とする記録を分けて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Delivery-status records alone don't establish that they checked the contents or accepted the application. Let's distinguish the records the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内容の受理は提出先に確認するのですね。それでは配達の記録を確認できる方法を比べて、料金も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容受理は提出先に確認すると理解し、配達記録のある方法と料金を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So acceptance of the contents must be checked with the recipient. I'd like to compare methods that provide delivery records, and hear the prices too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, acknowledge that acceptance of the contents must be checked with the recipient, and request a comparison of methods with delivery records and their prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる方法と料金を調べます。案内の締め切りには「必着」とありますが、その日までの到着を希望されていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the available methods and prices. The deadline says ‘must arrive by,’ so you want it to arrive by that date, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。「その日に出せばよい」という意味だと思っていました。到着日のことなら、間に合う見込みも発送前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必着を差出日と思っていたと伝え、到着期限に間に合う見込みを発送前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I thought it meant I only needed to send it that day. If it means the arrival date, I'd like to hear whether it is likely to make it before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you mistook the arrival deadline for the sending date, and ask before shipment about the prospects of arriving in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 到着の見込みを確認しますが、期限内の配達はお約束できません。提出先が別の提出方法を認めるかも、必要ならご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check expected arrival, but can't promise delivery before the deadline. If necessary, also check whether the recipient allows another submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必着の意味を取り違えていました。先に配達の見込みを聞き、難しければ提出先に別の方法を相談します。まだ封はせず、案内も残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まず到着見込みを聞き難しければ別提出方法を相談し、封をせず案内も保持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I misunderstood ‘must arrive by.’ I'll first ask about expected delivery, and if it's difficult, discuss another method with the recipient. I won't seal it yet, and I'll keep the instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will first ask about expected arrival and consult the recipient about alternatives if necessary, leaving the envelope unsealed and retaining the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず送り先と希望日で見込みをお調べします。その後、必要な記録と料金を確認してから発送方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: First we'll check the estimate for the destination and desired date. Then check the records you need and the fees before choosing a shipping method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のお申し込みの相談ですね。どのような用途をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice on applying for an account. What do you intend to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与を受け取るためです。ただ、勤務先の登録名と身分を示す書類の名前の並びが違うので、申込前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座希望だが勤務先登録と本人資料で氏名の並びが違い、申込前相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary. But the order of my names differs between my employer's registration and my identity documents, so I'd like advice before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want a salary account but the name order differs between employer records and your identity documents, so you want advice before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の書類を確認し、担当から記入方法をご案内します。ご自身でどちらかの名前を省略してそろえず、両方見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll examine the actual documents, and the staff will explain how to fill it in. Please show both without shortening either name yourself to make them match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方持っています。自分でミドルネームを省かず、そのまま見せます。勤務先にも、口座名義をどう届けるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両資料がありミドルネームを省かず提示し、勤務先への名義届出方法も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. I'll show them as they are without omitting my middle name myself. I'd also like to check with my employer how to report the account-holder name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you have both documents and will show them without omitting your middle name, and also want to check how to report the account name to your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点は勤務先の担当へご確認ください。住所については、今のお住まいを記したものがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check that with your employer's contact. As for your address, do you have something showing where you live now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引っ越したばかりで、持ってきた書類の一枚には前の住所が残っています。前の住所で申込欄を埋めるのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居直後で一枚に旧住所が残っており、古い住所で申込欄を埋めないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've just moved, and one document I brought still has my previous address. I shouldn't fill in the application with the old address, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that one document retains your old address after a recent move, and confirm that you will not fill the application with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の状況を正確にお伝えください。どの確認資料が必要かはこちらで照合し、古い住所をそのまま書くようにはご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please describe the current situation accurately. We'll check which supporting documents are necessary and won't tell you simply to copy the old address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では新しい住所を確認する資料が必要か、担当に聞きたいです。今日ある書類で足りない点を、書き出してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所の確認資料が必要かと、今の資料の不足点を書き出してもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'd like to ask the staff whether proof of the new address is needed. Could you write down what is missing from today's documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether supporting documents for the new address are needed and request a written list of what is missing from the documents you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した不足点と、まだ判断できない点を分けてお伝えします。ただ、一覧を受け取っただけで開設が決まるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll distinguish confirmed missing items from matters we can't yet decide. Receiving a list alone doesn't mean the account opening is approved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開設できると決まったのではなく、申込の準備の相談ですね。名前の記載と新住所の資料を確認してから、勤務先にも状況を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開設確定でなく準備相談と理解し、氏名記載と新住所資料を確認後に勤務先へ状況を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: So this is advice for preparing an application, not a decision that I can open an account. After checking the name format and new-address documents, I'll tell my employer the situation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, acknowledge that this is application preparation rather than confirmed account opening, and say you'll inform your employer after checking name entries and new-address documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その進め方で担当へ取り次ぎます。今お持ちの二種類の氏名資料と住所の資料を、分けてご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that plan to the staff. Please prepare your two name documents and address documents separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麦茶の売り場でお探しでしょうか。似た袋が並んでいるので、どの表示かご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking in the barley-tea section? The bags look similar, so I can explain which label applies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二十六袋入りを一つ買いたいです。この大きな特売札は、隣の五十二袋入りではなく、二十六袋のほうの値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十六袋一個を希望し、大きな特売札が五十二袋でなくどちらの商品か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like one pack of twenty-six bags. Is this large sale sign the price for the twenty-six-bag pack rather than the fifty-two-bag pack beside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, request one twenty-six-bag pack and ask which product the large sale sign applies to, rather than assuming it is the fifty-two-bag pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札の商品名には二十六袋入りとあります。ただ、その下に「二点購入時」と条件が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product name on the sign says twenty-six bags. But below it is the condition ‘when buying two.’

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つだけでもその値段だと思っていました。二点を買わない場合の価格は、どこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個にも特売が使えると思ったと伝え、二点買わない場合の価格表示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the price applied to one as well. Where is the price shown if I don't buy two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you thought the sale applied to one pack and ask where the price without buying two is displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つの場合はこちらの通常価格です。大きい五十二袋入りの価格は、隣の別の札にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For one, this is the regular price. The larger fifty-two-bag pack has a separate price sign next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五十二袋は量が多すぎるので、小さいもの一つにします。二点という条件に、別の味を組み合わせてもよいのかは気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五十二袋は多いため小袋一個を選び、二点の対象は別味も組合せ可か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Fifty-two bags is too much, so I'll take one small pack. I'm still curious whether the two-item condition allows combining different flavors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, choose one small pack because fifty-two bags is too much and ask whether different flavors can be combined under the two-item offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 組み合わせの対象はこの一覧で確認できますが、今回は一つをご希望でしたね。割引を使うためだけに二つへ変えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Eligible combinations can be checked in this list, but you wanted one this time. Would you change to two just to use the discount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、使い切れる量を優先して一つのままにします。通常価格の商品を選んだことを会計前にも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 割引目的で二個にせず使える量を優先し、会計前に通常価格を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I'll prioritize an amount I can finish and keep it to one. I'd also like to check before paying that I've chosen a regular-price item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't buy two just for the discount, will prioritize an amount you can use, and want to check the regular price before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この二十六袋入りのバーコードと通常価格を、レジで照合してもらえます。棚の札もこちらに示しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: At the register, they can compare this twenty-six-bag pack's barcode with the regular price. I'll indicate the shelf label here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では二十六袋入り一つを持って、レジで通常価格を確認します。大きな特売札の金額を一個の価格とは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二十六袋一個を持ちレジで通常価格を照合し、特売札を一個価格と誤解しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll take one twenty-six-bag pack and confirm the regular price at the register. I'll be careful not to treat the large sale-sign amount as the price for one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will take one twenty-six-bag pack, check the regular price at the register, and avoid mistaking the sale sign for a single-pack price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認の際は二十六袋入りで一つとお伝えください。必要でしたら売り場からもレジへご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. When checking, say it is one twenty-six-bag pack. If needed, we can explain it to the register from this section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のご案内でしょうか。歩いたあとに戻りたい場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like walking directions? Have you decided where you want to return afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に車で迎えに来てもらうので、この入口へ戻る約束です。長くは歩けないので、休憩できる短い道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の車の迎えは今の入口と伝え、長く歩けず休憩できる短い道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is picking me up by car, and we agreed I'd return to this entrance. I can't walk far, so I'd like a short route with somewhere to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say your friend's car pickup is at this entrance and request a short route with rest facilities because you cannot walk far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先の屋根のある休憩所まで往復する道があります。休憩所から別の出口へ抜ける道もありますが、お迎えはこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's an out-and-back path to the covered rest shelter ahead. A path also goes from the shelter to a different exit, but your pickup is here, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、迎えはこちらです。別の出口のほうが帰りの歩きは短いのですか。それなら友人と場所を変えられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎えは元入口だが別出口からの帰路が短いか尋ね、友人へ変更相談を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, pickup is here. Is the return walk shorter via the other exit? If so, I'd like to discuss changing the location with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, confirm the original pickup entrance, ask whether the other exit gives a shorter return walk, and consider discussing a change with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩所からの距離だけなら別の出口のほうが短いです。ただ、そこに車で来てもらえるかは、ここではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Considering only distance from the shelter, the other exit is closer. But we don't know here whether your friend can drive there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 距離だけで変更を決めないほうがよいですね。まず友人に連絡しますが、返事がない間は元の入口へ戻る計画にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 距離だけで変えず友人に連絡し、返事がなければ元入口へ戻る予定を維持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I shouldn't decide to change based only on distance. I'll contact my friend first, but while there's no reply I'll keep the plan to return to the original entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't change based only on distance, will contact your friend, and keep the original return plan without a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら迷いにくいですね。元の入口と休憩所はこの図の二か所です。目印として何を覚えておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That should help avoid confusion. The original entrance and shelter are these two places on the map. What landmarks will you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口の時計と、休憩所の屋根を覚えます。スマホの電池が少ないので、往復の道を紙に印で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口の時計と休憩所の屋根を目印にし、電池が少ないため紙に往復路を示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll remember the entrance clock and the shelter roof. My phone battery is low, so could you mark the out-and-back route on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, choose the entrance clock and shelter roof as landmarks and request the return route on paper because your battery is low.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙の図に往復路を示します。友人から変更の返事があっても、出口名を互いに確認してから動いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll mark it on the paper map. Even if your friend agrees to a change, confirm the exit name with each other before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出口名まで確認できなければ、時計のある元の入口に戻ります。今日は休憩所より先へは行かず、紙の図で往復します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出口名を相互確認できなければ元入口へ戻り、今日は休憩所までを紙の図で往復すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: If we can't confirm the exit name with each other, I'll return to the original entrance with the clock. Today I won't go beyond the shelter and will use the paper map for the round trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will return to the original entrance unless you mutually confirm the exit name, and will go only as far as the shelter using the paper map today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではこの図をお持ちください。お迎えの約束が変わらなければ、時計のある入口へ同じ道でお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this map. If your pickup arrangement doesn't change, return by the same path to the entrance with the clock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目的地までの検索結果ですね。線が分かれている所で迷われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are search results to your destination. Are you unsure where the line splits?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家へ行きます。この破線も列車だと思ったのですが、出発時刻が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人宅へ行く検索結果の破線を列車と思ったが出発時刻が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to my friend's home. I thought this dashed line was a train too, but can't find a departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you mistook the dashed line in the route to your friend's home for a train but cannot find its departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この検索結果では、その破線は二つの乗り場の間を歩く区間です。別の列車が出るという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: In these results, that dashed line is a walking section between two boarding points. It doesn't mean another train departs there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗り換えは全部ホームの中だと思っていました。いったん外へ出て歩くなら、道順も見ておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換はホーム内だけと思っていたと認め、外を歩くなら道順も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought every transfer took place inside the platforms. If I need to go outside and walk, I'd like to check the directions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, acknowledge that you thought all transfers were within the platforms and say you want directions if you have to walk outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この候補は出口を出て別の乗り場へ向かいます。地図で確かめましょう。歩く距離が少ない候補も比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This option leaves through an exit and heads to a different boarding point. Let's check the map. Would you compare options with less walking too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。足元が気になるので、少し遅く着いても徒歩の短い候補を見たいです。友人にも到着予定を変えるかもしれないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足元が気になるため遅くても徒歩の短い候補を比較し、友人へ予定変更の可能性を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'm concerned about walking conditions, so I'd like to see an option with less walking even if I arrive a little later. I'll tell my friend the arrival plan may change too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to compare less-walking options even if later because you're concerned about your footing, and will tell your friend the plan may change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの候補は徒歩区間が短い表示です。ただし検索上の目安なので、歩く速さや接続の状況で変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This option shows a shorter walking section. But it's a search estimate, so your walking pace and connections can change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示の到着時刻を約束はしません。こちらの候補の、列車を降りる所と歩き始める出口を区別して印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目安到着を約束せず、短い徒歩候補で降りる駅と歩き始める出口を分けて印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't promise the displayed arrival time. For this option, could you separately mark where I get off the train and the exit where I start walking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, avoid promising the estimated arrival and ask for separate marks for the station where you get off and the exit where you begin walking on the shorter-walking option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 降りる駅と、使う出口はこちらです。次に乗る列車の行き先も現地の表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the station where you get off and the exit to use. Check the next train's destination on the signs there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名と出口の印を見て進みます。破線の所で列車を待たず、徒歩の道順を確かめ、迷ったら出る前に係員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅と出口の印に従い、破線で列車を待たず道順を確認し不明なら外へ出る前に係員へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll follow the station-name and exit marks. I won't wait for a train at the dashed line; I'll check the walking directions, and if unsure ask staff before going outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will follow the station and exit marks, not wait for a train at the dashed line, check directions, and ask staff before leaving if unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 印を付けた紙をお渡しします。ご友人への連絡も含め、余裕を持ってお進みください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the marked paper. Allow yourself plenty of time, including for contacting your friend. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談ですね。提出先の案内と、今お持ちの書類を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about a certificate. May I see the recipient's instructions and the documents you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋を借りるために必要と言われました。以前取った証明書をコピーしてきたので、これを出せばよいかと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋の契約用に以前の証明書のコピーを持参し、それで足りると思っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told I need it to rent a room. I've brought a copy of a certificate obtained before and thought I could submit this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you brought a copy of an older certificate for a room rental and think it may be enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の物ですね。案内には証明書の名称はありますが、原本かコピーかの指定がこの部分だけではわかりません。住所も今のものと同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's an older one. The instructions name the certificate, but this part alone doesn't specify original or copy. Is the address the same as your current one too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このコピーは引っ越す前の住所です。紙があるだけで使えると思わず、今の住所が必要なのかも提出先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: コピーは旧住所なので、持っているだけで使えると考えず現住所の要否を提出先へ聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This copy shows my address before moving. Rather than assume it can be used just because I have the paper, I'd like to ask the recipient whether my current address is needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the copy shows your old address, so you won't assume possession makes it usable and want to ask whether the current address is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記載する住所と、原本かコピーかを分けて確認しましょう。発行時期についての指定は、案内の続きにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the address to include separately from original versus copy. Do the rest of the instructions specify the issue date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 続きのページはスマートフォンにありますが、まだ読んでいません。古い日付でもよいかを、自分で決めてはいけませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 続きの案内ページは未読で、古い発行日でもよいと自己判断しないと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The next page is on my phone, but I haven't read it yet. I shouldn't decide on my own that an old issue date is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you haven't read the remaining instruction page and confirm that you won't assume an old issue date is acceptable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのページも確認してから、不明な条件を提出先へ尋ねてください。余計な情報まで必要と思い込まず、指定の記載事項を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking that page too, ask the recipient about unclear conditions. Don't assume extra information is needed; confirm the specified entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所、発行時期、原本かコピーかの三つを聞きます。家族の情報まで必要かは案内でわからないので、それも質問に加えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所・発行時期・原本かコピーかを聞き、家族情報の要否も質問に追加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask three things: address, issue date, and original or copy. The instructions don't make clear whether family information is needed, so I'll add that question too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will ask about address, issue date, and original or copy, and add whether family information is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件がわかれば、こちらで扱える証明書と申請方法を担当へ相談できます。今のコピーは控えとしてお手元に残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the conditions, we can consult the staff about certificates handled here and how to apply. Will you keep your present copy for reference?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。このコピーには前の住所とメモして残します。今日は申請欄を埋めず、提出先の返事をそろえてから必要な物と費用を窓口で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧住所のコピーと明記して保管し、今日は申請せず条件確認後に必要物と費用を再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll keep it marked as my previous address. Today I won't fill in the application; after collecting the recipient's reply, I'll ask the counter about necessary items and fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide to retain the copy clearly marked as the old address, not apply today, and return about necessary items and fees after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類をお返しします。確認した条件の案内もお持ちになって、改めてご相談ください。本日のご案内はここまでです。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your documents back. Please bring the instructions showing the confirmed conditions and consult us again. That's all for today. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の言葉で迷っていらっしゃいますか。わからない所を指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure about a word on the medical questionnaire? Could you point to the part you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手について書きたいのですが、「しびれ」と「痛み」は同じ意味ですか。ずきずきする痛みとは違う感じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手の感覚を問診へ書きたいがしびれと痛みは同義か、ずきずきとは違うと聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to write about my hand. Do ‘tingling or numbness’ and ‘pain’ mean the same thing? It feels different from throbbing pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether the questionnaire words for numbness and pain mean the same thing, and say your hand sensation differs from throbbing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 言葉だけでひとまとめにせず、どんな感じかをご自身の言葉で伝えてください。どちらの手の、どのあたりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than lump it together under a word, describe the feeling in your own words. Which hand, and which part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右手の指先が、ぴりぴりするような感じです。二週間ほど前から、ときどき気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右手指先がぴりぴりし、二週間ほど前から時々気になると具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The fingertips of my right hand feel prickly or tingly. I've noticed it occasionally for about two weeks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, specifically describe tingling in your right fingertips, noticed occasionally since about two weeks ago.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右手の指先、二週間ほど前から時々、ということですね。この欄の「持続」は、感覚が続いているかを尋ねています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Right fingertips, occasionally for about two weeks, then. ‘Persistent’ in this field asks whether the sensation continues.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ずっと続くわけではありません。気にならない時間もあるので、「いつも」と書くより、出たり気にならなくなったりすると書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持続の意味を理解し、常時でなく気になる時とならない時があると書きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It doesn't continue all the time. There are periods when I don't notice it, so instead of writing ‘always,’ I'd like to write that it comes and goes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show that you understand persistent and want to write that it is not constant, with periods when you notice it and periods when you do not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経過をそのまま書いて、診察でもお話しください。わからない言葉を無理に選ばなくて大丈夫です。ほかに説明の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write that course as it is, and describe it during the examination too. You don't need to force yourself to choose unfamiliar words. Any other requests about explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 体の場所は図でも示したいです。診察の説明は、長い文を一度に言わず、短く区切ってもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所は図でも示したいと希望し、診察説明を短い文で区切ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to show the location on a diagram. It would help if explanations during the examination were broken into short parts rather than long sentences all at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, request to show the location on a diagram and ask for examination explanations to be broken into short sentences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図で示したいことと、短く区切った説明のご希望を担当へ伝えます。今、記入できた内容を読み直していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff that you want to use a diagram and receive explanations in short parts. Could you reread what you've filled in so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右手の指先、二週間ほど、ずっとではない、の三点を書きました。原因の病名を自分で書き足さず、この感じを図と一緒に診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 右手指先・二週間ほど・常時でないの三点を見直し、病名を自己記入せず図と感覚で診察時に説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written three points: right fingertips, about two weeks, and not all the time. I won't add a disease name as the cause myself; I'll explain the sensation with the diagram during the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, review right fingertips, about two weeks, and not constant, and say you will explain using the sensation and diagram without entering your own diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入とご希望を受け取りました。診療担当へ引き継ぎますので、症状の判断については診察でご相談ください。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your form and requests. I'll pass them to the clinical staff, so consult them during the examination about assessing the symptoms. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不安なメッセージのご相談ですね。今、相手と会っている状況ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about an unsettling message. Are you currently meeting the other person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会っていません。知らない相手から今日中に払えと何度も来て、怖くなって相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手と会っておらず、知らない相手から当日支払い要求が繰り返し届いて怖いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. An unknown person keeps demanding payment today, and I became frightened and came for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you are not meeting them, and repeated same-day payment demands from an unknown person have frightened you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届いた内容と時刻を確認します。お金を送ったり、情報を入力したり、返信したりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the content and times received. Have you sent money, entered information, or replied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何もしていないと言おうとしましたが、最初に自分の名前だけ返信しました。送金もリンクへの入力もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名だけ返信した事実を訂正して伝え、送金とリンク入力はしていないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was about to say I hadn't done anything, but I did reply with only my name at first. I haven't sent money or entered information through a link.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, correct yourself to disclose that you replied with your name only, distinguishing this from sending money or entering information through a link, which you have not done.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信したことも含め、わかっている順にお聞きします。元のメッセージは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask in the order you know, including your reply. Do you still have the original messages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。相手の文と私の返信は残っています。消したくなりましたが、受け取った時刻がわかる画面も保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手文と自分返信が残り、削除したいと思ったが受信時刻の画面も保存したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Their messages and my reply remain. I wanted to delete them, but also saved screens showing when they arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that their messages and your reply remain and, although you wanted to delete them, you saved screens showing receipt times too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を見ながら確認しましょう。今ここで相手へ返信したり電話をかけたりせず、まず経過を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the records. Don't reply or call them here now; first we'll organize what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで折り返して相手を確かめようとはしません。今朝の一通目、名前を返した時刻、その後の要求を順番にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手へ折り返さず、一通目・氏名返信・その後要求を時系列のメモへまとめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't call back here to find out who they are. I'll make a chronological note of this morning's first message, when I replied with my name, and the demands afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't contact them back and will make a chronological note of the first message, your name reply, and later demands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番なら伝わります。保存した記録と、既に伝えた情報を担当に見せてください。画面を見ただけで被害がないと断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That order will make it clear. Show the staff your saved records and the information you've already disclosed. Looking at a screen alone can't establish that there has been no harm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前を返したことを省かず、元の文とメモを担当へ見せます。まだ何もわからないまま払ったり会いに行ったりせず、次の対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名返信を省略せず原文とメモを担当へ示し、払う・会うと決めず次の対応を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the staff the originals and notes without leaving out that I replied with my name. I won't pay or go to meet them while the situation is still unclear; I'll consult about the next steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will show the original messages and notes without omitting the name reply, and consult about next steps without deciding to pay or meet them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談の経過をまとめて担当へつなぎます。記録はこのままお持ちになり、こちらの席へどうぞ。状況が変わって相手が近くに来た場合は、そのこともすぐお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll summarize the consultation so far and connect you with the staff. Keep your records as they are and come to this seat. If things change and the person comes near you, tell us immediately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱をお送りになるご相談ですね。送り先と中身を順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to send this box. Please tell me the destination and contents in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の家族へ、衣類を送りたいです。箱は閉じましたが、まだ宛名は貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内家族宛ての衣類の箱で、封はしたが宛名は未貼付と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send clothes to my family within Japan. I've closed the box, but haven't attached the address label yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the box contains clothes for family within Japan, is sealed, but has no address label attached yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 衣類だけでしょうか。ほかに入れた物も、わかる範囲で具体的にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Only clothes? Please tell us specifically about anything else inside as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そう聞かれて思い出しました。服の下に音の出る玩具もあります。電池が入ったままかもしれず、衣類だけという説明は訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣類の下に音の出る電池入りかもしれない玩具もあると思い出し、衣類だけとの説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Your question reminded me. There's also a toy that makes sounds under the clothes. It may still have batteries inside, so I'll correct my statement that it contains only clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, remember that there is also a sound-making toy under the clothes that may contain batteries, and correct the clothes-only description.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身を訂正していただきありがとうございます。電池の種類や製品の情報など、確認が必要な点があります。今わかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for correcting the contents. We need to check things such as battery type and product information. Do you have any information available now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 品名の箱も説明書も家にあります。電池の種類を推測で答えず、家で製品情報を確認して持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書と製品箱は家なので電池種類を推測せず資料を確認して持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The product box and manual are at home. I won't guess the battery type; I'll check the product information at home and bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the manual and product box are at home, so you will not guess the battery type but check the information and bring it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる情報がそろってから、利用できる方法と取扱条件を担当へご相談ください。現時点では受付できるとは決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have the verifiable information, consult the staff about available methods and handling conditions. Acceptance has not been confirmed at this stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この箱のままで送れると家族に約束するのはやめます。玩具の型番と電池について、何を確認すればよいか質問を控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送付可と家族へ約束せず、型番と電池について確認すべき質問を控えたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stop promising my family this box can be shipped as it is. I'd like to note the questions about what to check for the toy model and batteries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, avoid promising your family it can be sent and request notes on what to check about the model and batteries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 製品名や型番、電池について不明な点を、この確認メモに記します。電池の外し方や梱包を自己流で決める前に、製品案内と取扱条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll write unknown points about the product name, model and batteries on this check memo. Before deciding your own battery-removal or packing method, check the product instructions and shipping conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを持ち帰り、衣類と玩具の内容を一覧にします。今日は差し出さず、製品情報を確認してから、送料と追跡の有無も一緒に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容一覧と製品情報を準備するため今日は差し出さず、後で送料と追跡も含め再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the memo home and list the clothes and toy. I won't send it today; after checking product information, I'll also ask about postage and whether tracking is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide not to send today while preparing a contents list and product information, and to consult again later about postage and tracking too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は受付をせず、箱をお返しします。内容の一覧とわかる資料をお持ちになって改めてご相談ください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We won't accept it today; here's your box back. Please return for advice with the contents list and information you can provide. Thank you for asking.
